== Device Management

- *Device Management* now has one *Settings* button at the top of the page. The button is available to all organizations and opens the *Settings* window for host machine settings.
- Host machine rows no longer have a per-machine *Settings* button.
- For organizations subscribed to virtualUSB, host machines with virtualUSB enabled show a *virtualUSB* badge on their row.
